advisories.text: Detached streams are keyed by `Upstream.String()`. A path with dynamic upstreams, or two handlers sharing one upstream address, is not shown to be tested; the closing rule relies on the `hosts` pool refcount.
The `ready`/`readyOnce` machinery is somewhat heavy. It is needed to avoid a race with `Cleanup`, so it is acceptable.

Detaching applies only to hijacked HTTP/1.1 connections. With `stream_detached` set, an HTTP/2 extended CONNECT stream silently falls back to non-detached behaviour. This is reasonable but undocumented, and no test asserts it.
